title: Attestable Audits: Verifiable AI Safety Benchmarks Using Trusted Execution Environments
reasoning: The paper focuses on the technical implementation of an audit protocol using Trusted Execution Environments (TEEs). While it evaluates its system using safety benchmarks like toxicity and bias, it does not specifically benchmark religion, faith, or perform a primary ethical or moral evaluation beyond using existing safety benchmarks as a proof-of-concept for its security protocol.
